description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProductViewed' in the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing product view statistics such as installation, data insertion, retrieval, and clearing of viewed product data in the database.
external_files: Database connection via $this->db in engine Model

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: A PHP class managing product view reports in an Opencart extension, including database setup, data insertion, retrieval, and cleanup.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_viewed' table in the database if it does not exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_viewed' table from the database if it exists.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts or updates the view count for a specific product into the database.

methods.name: getViewed
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products with their view counts, ordered by views descending, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalViewed
methods.description: Returns the total number of view records.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the sum of all views across all products.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Truncates the 'product_viewed' table, clearing all view data.
